newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN LOSES GROUND AFTER H1 TURNOVER FALLS.
newsitem.headline: GAN LOSES GROUND AFTER H1 TURNOVER FALLS.

text.p: Shares in French state-controlled insurer GAN were lower after the release of first-half figures showing its turnover dropped 10.16 percent to 12.11 billion francs.
By 0939 GMT, shares were off 0.96 percent at 145.10 francs, slightly underperforming the blue-chip CAC-40 index which was down 0.56 percent.
GAN's turnover was down 6.9 percent on a like for like basis.
Separately, the company announced late Friday that it had sold a portfolio of distressed real estate worth a gross three billion francs as it geared up for its planned privatisation.
